description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for followers in an ASP.NET Core application, allowing the removal of a follower relationship based on username. It includes command validation, database handling via Entity Framework Core, and response handling with profile data.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic to remove a follower relationship and returns the profile info.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to delete a follower by username, performs database lookups, removes follow relation if exists, and returns the profile.
